titlePolicy: Titles are descriptive catalog labels, not confirmed artist titles. Medium, date, dimensions, biography and availability remain unconfirmed unless explicit in source folders.

collections.title: Digital works
collections.description: Expressive figures, observed streets and layered lines. Four series drawn in Procreate.

collections.title: Studies in red
collections.description: A red line moves through rooms, rooftops and city streets. Two connected groups of drawings.

collections.title: From the studio
collections.description: Painted architecture and studies of the human figure. Collected works from the studio.

series.title: Colour & body
series.description: Green figures, loose gestures and fields of colour. A series exploring pose, proportion and the space around the body.

series.title: Street notes
series.description: Stairways, courtyards and ordinary corners, observed in dark lines with occasional flashes of red.

series.title: Graphic stories
series.description: Figures overlap, gestures repeat, and red becomes a rhythm. Small scenes with a graphic sensibility.

series.title: Animal lines
series.description: Five animal studies built from overlapping red and black lines.

series.title: The red city
series.description: Facades, rooftops, crossings and windows. Red drawing meets blocks of colour and repeated architectural forms.

series.title: Rooms & windows
series.description: A quieter group of interior fragments: a cat, an open window and figures at the edge of a room.

series.title: City & structure
series.description: Bridges, stations and buildings hold their own presence. Painted spaces and figures meet within layered architectural compositions.

series.title: Figure studies
series.description: Portraits, seated poses and anatomical studies, moving between close observation and expressive marks.
